candidate: frozen v1 calibration arm; line-specific betting capability not yet implemented/validated
comparison: official frozen architecture; independent Elo winner; same-book no-vig at identical line/time/scope
pilot: first 100 fully eligible new event identities per market after registration; exclude all existing forecast events and every pilot event from later confirmation
confirmation: NOT_OPEN. After pilot, register fixed sample size, eligible games and model/algorithm hashes before observing confirmation outcomes. No automatic transition.
power: 80% target power at familywise alpha .05 across 3 markets (per-market .0166667); pilot week-cluster variance; practical Brier improvement .005; minimum 300 independent games per market and 12 game weeks, increase to power requirement; insufficient clusters stays blocked
primary_endpoint: paired conditional Brier on nonpush; report push frequency, W/P/L proper scores and infinite logloss without clipping
pass_requirements: paired week-cluster CI upper bound below -.005 versus contemporaneous no-vig
ROI multiplicity-adjusted lower bound above zero under preregistered event-capped portfolio
stable heldout seasons and all VALIDATION_RULES requirements
independent authentication and explicit user promotion permission
selection: one exact authenticated Hard Rock Florida pair per event: highest positive W/P/L EV among qualifying candidates; ties market then selection lexicographic; no cross-book substitution
paper_risk: one unit max per event, five units daily; no bankroll ledger edits; actual risk zero
required_inputs: observed pregame roster/QB/injury roles and original report timing
exact authenticated paired prices and scope
date-aware market-line inference and model hashes
replacement_rule: non-QB verified actual replacement first; otherwise mean highest-rated up to three available same-position players strictly below injured player; fewer uses available count; none unknown. QB needs verified starter/replacement. No EA rating-to-points coefficient assumed.
injury_model: known contributions only; unknown omitted explicitly, full-game recommendations remain blocked by material uncertainty; comparator-bound coefficients and baseline-relative workload required
trap_momentum: separate existing definitions/ablations, never fitted or applied without vintaged inputs
